10|
11|`git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only` (31 files). Non-doc changes are presentation-only under `frontend/src/components/`:
12|
13|- New: `common/TruncatedText.jsx` + `common/TruncatedText.test.jsx` (49 + 83 lines)

Searched the diff for `factory|barrel|singleton|observer|adapter|facade`, `class `, `new `, `this.`, `prototype` — no design-pattern language, no class definitions, no OOP state. `new Error` appears only as standard mock-rejection construction in tests, not as a class abstraction.
20|
21|## Findings by principle
22|
23|### 1. User understandable over technical language — PASS
24|
25|- Descriptive names: new locals are long and plain (`extraStyling`, `tooltipText` in `TruncatedText.jsx:31,35`); test constants are explicit (`LONG_SPACED`, `LONG_SPACELESS`, `LONG_STAGE` in `WorkflowManagementPanel.overflow.test.jsx:17-19`; `LONG_SKILL`, `LONG_ALIAS`, `LONG_KEYWORD_KEY`, `LONG_MODEL_REF`, `LONG_HARNESS_ID` in `SettingsCards.overflow.test.jsx:31-37`).
26|- No banned jargon: no `factory`/`barrel` or GoF pattern names anywhere in the code diff. The word “pattern” in `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` / `OVERFLOW_FIX_NOTE.md` means the shared CSS truncation recipe, not a design pattern, and is never used as a GoF term.
27|- Common language preserved: domain words stay `workflow`, `stage`, `skill`, `alias`, `key`, `user`, `project`. The helper is generic (`TruncatedText`) by intent — it must serve many cards — and does not introduce a competing domain synonym.
28|- File structure mirrors the call stack: helper in `components/common/` (lowest shared folder), settings callers in `components/settings/`, tests beside subjects.
29|- JSDoc + why + `@example`: `TruncatedText.jsx:1-23` explains in plain words what breaks and why (shrinkable flex item, width cap for non-flex reuse, ellipsis, hover/screen-reader discoverability, empty-label fail-safe), documents each `props` field, and gives `@example <TruncatedText text={workflow.name} ... />`. The default-export block (`:44-48`) and both new suites (`TruncatedText.test.jsx:6-13`, `WorkflowManagementPanel.overflow.test.jsx:7-15`, `SettingsCards.overflow.test.jsx:10-16`) carry `MARK` + `@description` stating why they exist (single regression contract, not just what). `WorkflowManagementPanel.jsx:6-13` retains its `MARK`/`@example`. `OVERFLOW_FIX_NOTE.md` records why for every file (e.g. “was spilling 197px at 320px”, “spaceless routes”, “quotes the rejected path”).
30|- Labelled data inport: `TruncatedText({ text, className, title, id })` (`TruncatedText.jsx:24`) and every call site (`text={wf.name}`, `text={skill.name}`, `text={key.name}`, `text={user.email}`, `text={provider.label || provider.id}`, `text={formatAliasSummary(...)}`) picks the needed field by name. No new whole-object passing.
31|
32|### 2. Functional over object oriented — PASS
33|
34|- No classes: zero `class` definitions, no `extends`, no `constructor`, no `this`, no prototype patching in the diff. `TruncatedText` is a plain function component; all touched components stay function components.
35|- No curried pseudo-classes or hidden state machines introduced.
36|- Black-box / immutable / single responsibility: `TruncatedText` is pure (same inputs → same output, no side effects, props never mutated, no `useState`/`useEffect`). It does one job: overflow-safe one-line label.
37|- Minimum data: helper takes only the four props it uses; usage sites pass only those. Pre-existing positional calls such as `stageTypeColor(stage.type)` were left untouched and are not new violations.
38|
39|### 3. Co-location over abstraction — PASS
40|
41|- Tests beside subjects: `TruncatedText.test.jsx` next to `TruncatedText.jsx`; both `.overflow.test.jsx` suites in `settings/` beside the components they cover. No separate `__tests__` folders added.
42|- Folder-per-caller rule respected in spirit: shared helper lives at the lowest common ancestor (`components/common/`) rather than duplicated under each settings subfolder.
43|- Helper justified by repetition: `TruncatedText` is genuinely reused — `WorkflowManagementPanel` (name + stages), `SkillsSection`, `ApiKeysSection`, `AccessUserList` (name + email), `ModelAliasesSection` (header + summary), `ImageGenSection` — 8+ call sites across 6 files, each previously hand-rolling `truncate`/`min-w-0`/`title` imperfectly. `OVERFLOW_FIX_NOTE.md:5-12` mandates reuse and forbids per-card hand-rolling.
44|- No single-line over-abstraction: the helper encapsulates five guard classes plus tooltip defaulting, empty-string handling, `String()` coercion, `className` sanitisation, and `id` passthrough — more than a one-line class repeat, with error-prone fail-safe logic that would drift if copied. Conversely, the many `break-words`/`break-all` message lines are deliberately left inline per site, respecting “don’t abstract a single line”.
45|- Searchable: filenames `TruncatedText`, `WorkflowManagementPanel.overflow.test`, `SettingsCards.overflow.test` and the `OVERFLOW_FIX_NOTE.md` applied-to table make any Settings overflow site findable in one lookup.
46|
47|### 4. Tested over trusted — PASS
48|
49|- Tests planned before code: `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` Steps 1–2 plan the regression scaffold and sibling audit before Step 3 applies the pattern everywhere, with explicit checkpoint gates (reproduce → prove in isolation → audit → apply → verify). The note lists the exact suites to pin.
50|- Fail-safe pinned: `TruncatedText.test.jsx` covers null/undefined/empty → empty label with no `title` (never “undefined”/“null”, never a crash), number → string tooltip, non-string `className` ignored, spaceless strings on one clipped line, `id` passthrough for `aria-labelledby`. This is the “don’t assume typing, fail safe” principle made executable.
51|- Consistent and lowest-level: all new/strengthened tests use existing `vitest` + `@testing-library/react` + `renderWithKainBain`, asserting the same contract (`toHaveClass('min-w-0','truncate')`, `toHaveAttribute('title', fullName)`, `break-words`/`break-all`). Existing suites were only extended (additive `toHaveClass`/`title` assertions, one new delete-failure case in `SkillsSection.test.jsx`); no behavioral assertion was deleted or weakened.
52|- User-like integration: overflow tests exercise real user actions — expanding collapsed alias cards (`SettingsCards.overflow.test.jsx:94-104`), toggling skill config (`:159`), opening preview modal (`:187-193`), clicking `Rename`, `Switch to Active`, `Make Default`, `Delete` beside a 200-char name (`WorkflowManagementPanel.overflow.test.jsx:87-103`) — rather than isolated class-only checks. jsdom pixel limits are honestly documented; visual proof is delegated to the three headless screenshots, not faked in jsdom.
53|- No new e2e layer added; visual checks reuse the existing capture tooling.
54|
55|### 5. Fast iteration over long planning — PASS
56|
57|- Checkpointed plan: `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` factors in check points (Step 0 fixture + 320/768/1455px before-screenshots, Step 1 isolation proof, Step 2 hit-list disposition, Step 4 after-screenshots + gates) and adaptation points (survey q1–q4 assumptions reversible; Step 3d redesign fallback only if truncation still looks unworkable).
58|- Safe, non-prod testing: fixtures use synthetic 60–200-char spaced and spaceless names; no production workflow/skill data is mutated.
59|- Small, reversible change: diff touches only className/layout wrappers and the new presentational helper — no API, persistence, or event-handler changes. Plan states rollback is a revert of the component diff.
60|- Built to be swapped: truncate-vs-wrap choice lives in one helper, so flipping the q2 default is a one-place change; companion `min-w-0`/`shrink-0` guards are local to usage sites and documented as such in `OVERFLOW_FIX_NOTE.md:20-30`.
61|

63|
64|- `npm run test --prefix frontend -- src/components/common/TruncatedText.test.jsx src/components/settings/WorkflowManagementPanel.overflow.test.jsx src/components/settings/SettingsCards.overflow.test.jsx` → **3 files, 21 tests, all passed** (1.88s).

Update existing call sites to drop the now-redundant workaround classes where safe, keep full frontend tests and lint green, and add a regression test rendering a long spaceless label asserting containment classes/attributes.
